title: Solving a corner-to-corner transformation
description: You can follow matched coordinate pairs into a homography matrix.

steps.description: A homography maps planar coordinates using a matrix up to scale. You add two equation rows for each paired source and destination corner.
The code applies singular value decomposition to A. You reshape the final row of Vt into a three-by-three matrix and normalize by its bottom-right entry.

steps.question: Which direction does this call request for the mapping?
steps.answer: It maps overlay_corners as the source toward marker_corners as the destination.

steps.description: You print H with precision set to three and small-value suppression enabled. The recorded matrix has bottom-right entry 1 and last-column values 150 and 90 above it.
